items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Velsheim would play that man. Because that's on the record.

ctx.x: Well you did play Gettysburg and 6-8s.

Oh yeah, we played that, but Velsheim would play that man. Because that's on the record. They want all that gut books, they want Tiger Rack, High Society, Clannett Marble, the blues, all that kind of stuff they wanted, you know? All they wanted was something hot, man. But see when they wanted a nice march band, they go get the Eureka or either the Tuxedo band, you know them fellas. A Eureka band had some nice marches. I played once or twice and I went to their rehearsal.
